title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Court on Whether the Infringement of Citizens' Basic Right to Education Protected by the Constitution by Means of Infringing the Right to Name Shall Bear Civil Liability

articles.content_en:
Fa Shi [2001] No. 25
Higher People's Court of Shandong Province:
We have received your court's Request for Instructions (〔1999〕Lu Min Zhong Zi No. 258) concerning the dispute over the right to name between Qi Yuling and Chen Xiaoqi, Chen Kezheng, Jinan Commercial School of Shandong Province, No. 8 Middle School of Tengzhou City of Shandong Province, and Education Committee of Tengzhou City of Shandong Province. Upon examination, we are of the opinion that, based on the facts of this case, Chen Xiaoqi et al., by means of infringing upon the right to name, have infringed upon the fundamental right to education that Qi Yuling enjoys pursuant to the provisions of the Constitution, and have caused concrete harmful consequences, and therefore shall bear corresponding civil liability.
